bands.label: Strong
bands.meaning: High confidence result; only minor field/family-level misses.

bands.label: Moderate
bands.meaning: Material misses (this range overlaps the repo's ambiguous band [0.5, 0.85] that triggers a judge review pass).

bands.label: Weak
bands.meaning: Poor result; the model is missing or misclassifying core content.

scoring_guide.general: All scores are deterministic and computed locally — no LLM grading. The markdown log, manifests, and this site all read the same numbers. Compare runs only on the SAME sample (same dataset, seed, and size): accuracy deltas across different samples are meaningless.

contract_entity_extraction.summary: How faithfully the contracts-specialist extracted every expected field from the contract text, per field's declared type.
contract_entity_extraction.formula: mean of the per-field content scores over expected fields with a non-null ground-truth value
contract_entity_extraction.conveys: End-to-end extraction quality: dates/money exact, names fuzzy-matched, clauses containment-scored, entity lists bipartite-matched against ground truth.

components.label: Overall extraction
components.calculation: mean of per-field content scores
components.meaning: Composite content accuracy across all expected fields.

components.label: Field presence
components.calculation: share of expected fields the model populated (non-null/non-empty)
components.meaning: Did the model produce a value at all, regardless of correctness?

components.label: Schema valid
components.calculation: 1.0 iff output is parseable, schema-conformant JSON
components.meaning: Output-contract conformance — 0 means the row was unusable.

components.label: Per-field scores
components.calculation: type-aware: date/money exact; name fuzzy (Jaro-Winkler + token-set); free_text SQuAD token F1; entity_list optimal bipartite matching at 0.6 threshold; containment = expected-token coverage
components.meaning: Where exactly quality is gained or lost.

chained_sorter_extractor.summary: The full sorter → specialist chain: the sorter classifies the document, then the specialist extracts with that context.
chained_sorter_extractor.formula: headline = the specialist's overall_extraction_score (same composite as the extraction task); the sorter's doc-type match is shown alongside
chained_sorter_extractor.conveys: End-to-end pipeline quality — both stages must work.

components.label: Sorter doc-type match
components.calculation: 1.0 iff doc_type == 'contract'
components.meaning: The sorter sent the document down the contract path.

components.label: Sorter subtype accuracy
components.calculation: 1.0 iff doc_type AND normalized contract subtype match the CUAD folder
components.meaning: Contract-family routing quality.

components.label: Extractor overall
components.calculation: mean of per-field content scores (see extraction task)
components.meaning: Field extraction quality given the sorter's context.

components.label: Verified precision
components.calculation: factuality guard: share of predicted items that match a GT label OR are grounded in the document (token coverage ≥ 0.7)
components.meaning: Truthfulness — how much of the output is real, not hallucinated.

components.label: Category presence
components.calculation: share of the document's applicable CUAD presence-categories covered
components.meaning: Did the extraction cover the labeled clauses that must appear?

components.label: Field presence
components.calculation: share of expected fields populated
components.meaning: Completeness of output fields.

subtype_classification.summary: The sorter-only task: one call per document that decides the primary class (contract or not) AND the contract-subtype family.
subtype_classification.formula: headline = strict subtype accuracy: share of rows whose normalized predicted subtype exactly equals the CUAD ground-truth folder
subtype_classification.conveys: Routing quality: strict is the discriminating signal; equiv allows defensible family swaps (reseller↔distributor, maintenance↔license, development↔license, affiliate↔joint_venture).

components.label: Doc-type accuracy (exact_match)
components.calculation: share of rows where doc_type == 'contract'
components.meaning: Primary-class correctness (every CUAD row is a contract).

components.label: Subtype strict
components.calculation: share of rows where normalized subtype == CUAD folder exactly
components.meaning: Exact family-level routing.

components.label: Subtype equiv
components.calculation: strict OR defensible equivalent family
components.meaning: How often the model routed to a legally-defensible family.

components.label: Confidence
components.calculation: mean of the model's reported per-row confidence
components.meaning: Calibration signal — how sure the model claims to be.

components.label: Failed rows
components.calculation: rows with subtype_ok == false, broken down by failure mode
components.meaning: modes: family_confusion (wrong family), function_over_form (doc_type miss), other_fallback (fell to 'other'), equivalent_family (recovered by equivalence)

legalbench_binary_answer.summary: LegalBench suite (llm-mailroom/legalbench/) — CUAD contract-QA binary-answer task: yes/no questions over contracts with evidence spans, scored against the CUAD annotations.
legalbench_binary_answer.formula: headline = share of questions answered correctly (predicted yes/no == annotation)
legalbench_binary_answer.conveys: Contract-comprehension accuracy on a large, real legal QA corpus.

components.label: Accuracy
components.calculation: share of questions with predicted == expected
components.meaning: Headline comprehension quality.

components.label: Macro category accuracy
components.calculation: mean of per-clause-category accuracies (41 categories)
components.meaning: Whether any clause family is disproportionately hard.

components.label: Yes-class F1
components.calculation: F1 for answering 'yes' (precision/recall over yes predictions vs yes labels)
components.meaning: False-positive tendency on affirmative answers.

components.label: Confidence mean
components.calculation: mean of the model's reported per-question confidence
components.meaning: Calibration signal.

components.label: Calibration error (ECE)
components.calculation: expected calibration error over confidence/outcome pairs
components.meaning: How well confidence matches observed correctness.

legalbench_multiclass_classification.summary: LegalBench suite (llm-mailroom/legalbench/) — CUAD contract-family classification: assign one of the 25 contract families (+ other) to each contract, scored against the family derived from the CUAD folder/title taxonomy.
legalbench_multiclass_classification.formula: headline = strict family accuracy; equiv additionally accepts defensible family swaps (same SUBTYPE_EQUIVALENCES as the sorter)
legalbench_multiclass_classification.conveys: Multiclass legal-routing accuracy with a defensible-equivalence lens.

components.label: Strict accuracy
components.calculation: share of documents whose family key matches exactly
components.meaning: Exact family-level routing.

components.label: Equiv accuracy
components.calculation: strict OR defensible equivalent family
components.meaning: Routing to a legally-defensible family.

components.label: Macro F1
components.calculation: mean one-vs-rest F1 over families with labels present
components.meaning: Class balance-adjusted quality.

components.label: Confidence mean
components.calculation: mean of the model's reported per-document confidence
components.meaning: Calibration signal.
